reviews.t: High Quality Product, Well Designed. Closest Shave I've Had in Years.
reviews.x: The first time I used this razor, I cut myself. I hadn’t cut myself shaving in about 20 years. The reason I cut myself is because this razor is engineered properly. This may sound contradictory, so let me explain. In most safety razors, the blade is recessed too much and is at an angle that is considered optimum to prevent nicks and cuts. Because in typical razors the blade is recessed too far, the shaver must press harder to reach the whiskers. Still, the shaver will require two to three passes

I tried holding the razor at different angles to my face.  I tried loosening the razor head, the only result of which was a severe cut above my upper lip. reviews.t: Extremely good quality that improves shaving immensely
reviews.x: This razor is absolutely amazing. I had a cheap double edge safety razor that I absolutely hated, it was rough to use and constantly irritated my skin.  I got this thinking "What the heck, I got 20$ to spend why not, looks nice" and it blew my expectations out of the water. I literally used a used blade from my old razor since I was all out of new ones and it was like shaving with a brand new blade.  Seriously if you're on the fence about this item, go for it. Its amazing and it feels like a 5+

reviews.t: Super smooth shaves with a beautiful razor

It took me a few shaves to learn how to use it without cutting myself multiple times. I went back to disposable razors. On a whim I decided to look into safety razors again. I bought this razor and was pleasantly surprised. The look and design are beautiful. From the first use it has been super smooth and no nicks or cuts. It’s as easy to use as a disposable but so much cheape

reviews.t: A product designed the way it should be!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.x: Over the past few years many razor mfg's have moved their mfg to china.... I'm not saying this is bad or good, but china mfg typically has a 15% defect (their QA) at the consumer level.... and if you look at the majority of razor reviews, they fall right into that category.  Although the product design may be the same, production related QA is far from good....and I have had my share of this type of crap from a variety of name brand mfg's.  This razor is designed and built the way they use to be

reviews.t: You won’t regret it! Top notch

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the razor's build quality, weight, and finish, calling it well-made and good value for the price.
Several reviewers report cuts or difficulty getting a good shave, with some giving up on the razor entirely.
A recurring complaint is that the screw/threads stop tightening or holding the head securely over time.
Some reviewers feel the razor is plasticky or cheap-feeling, particularly the handle casing.
Multiple reviewers find the razor easy to use, including first-time safety razor users and daily shavers.
